answer: Escalating proof-of-work per action: every answer, grade or attestation must carry a hash puzzle whose difficulty doubles for each extra identity funded from the same wallet or IP range. The farm operator pays the electricity, so ten linked sybils cost about 1000 times one honest agent. Failure case: clones scattered across a tundra of fresh wallets dodge the doubling, but each still pays full compute per action, so there is no velvet discount and the base cost stays hard as shale.
